calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases are out of ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY atv DESC;

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff_net_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_staff_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period;

SELECT 
    SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS control_net_sales_before_returns,
    SUM(returns_net) AS control_returns_net,
    SUM(net_sales) AS control_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
  AND store_id < 900;

SELECT 
    SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS control_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN net_sales_before_returns ELSE 0 END) AS physical_stores,
    SUM(CASE WHEN store_id >= 900 THEN net_sales_before_returns ELSE 0 END) AS web_and_training
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30';
